title: Trilium Notes ETAPI
summary: Search, read, create and delete Trilium Notes through the ETAPI token, exposed as a narrow MCP surface with read-only and full-access variants.

review.notes: Compatibility reviewed against Trilium ETAPI in 0.105.0. Operations cover the reviewed ETAPI subset only; the upstream OpenAPI document is not redistributed here.

secrets.name: TRILIUM_ETAPI_TOKEN
secrets.description: A Trilium ETAPI token created in Options -> ETAPI. Sent as the Authorization bearer for /etapi requests.

provenance.notes: The Manifest was authored by MCPiler from the reviewed ETAPI behavior; no upstream specification text is copied.
